instagram.body:
Is anyone else frustrated with the dating scene??? 

#christiandating #dating #christian #relationships #singleseason
Everybody's frustrated in the dating scene right now. You know, when you're single, you kind of evaluate where else I can find people. So, you know, I'm looking at church. I'm looking at people who follow me on social media. You're looking around, and it's pretty hard to find someone who matches your energy and has the same beliefs as you. And these other dating apps, they're full of a bunch of lukewarm people. And I came across a dating app, as I was doing my research, that actually lets you do all sorts of spiritual questions like Bible verification, what you're reading in your Bible, what specific denominations you are, what specific things you believe. Why are we not thinking about this earlier? The amount of Christian singles that are going to be married because of this app is going to be like breaking news down the line. What more could you want? I mean, an exact pool of everybody who believes the exact same things as you that you get to choose from. So, if you're still single, go get on it.

tiktok.author: theratchetchristian
tiktok.body:
Please tell me I'm not the only creator going through this right now? Truthfully it makes me not even want to post anymore. #creators #creatorstiktok #adviceforcreators #communityguidelines
The censorship, the Community Guidelines violation left and right. Like, it's so frustrating and almost feels like they don't want creators on this app. Like, you don't know that you've done something wrong or said something wrong until you post it. And then it's like, I'll say something that's community guidelines violation. Gets my video taken down, gives me an account strike, and then I will scroll, see somebody else saying the same exact thing, and they have 50,000 likes and, uh, half a million views. You know what I mean? It's like, before I got up to a certain following, I was able to do and say whatever it is that I want. Once I got to a certain following, it's like, the strictness on my page. Like, the censorship I'm going through. Like, I'm a person of substance. I wanna talk about things of substance, but when I do, I kind of get, like, a slap on the wrist for it. So if you see me talking about a lot more fluff, that's why I can only talk about nonsense on here now, or else I get in trouble. And I just think that's kind of wack. Like, I used to love TikTok, but it's being increasingly frustrating to be on here.
